text:
Zoe Park: Quick sync — can we lock a time for a cross-functional priority roundtable next Tue? Need 60m to resolve the API rollout vs Dedicated capacity slotting. Prefer early PT so EU folks can join for the tail end.

Miguel Santos: +1. Infra is still waiting on a decision; we have a capacity delta that affects the Dedicated rollout ETA. 9am PT works for me.

Priya Patel: Adding RFC #421 (continuous batching changes) to the agenda — needs 15m. Also a short rubric review for priority scoring (5m).

Zoe Park: Proposed agenda (rough):
```
- 10m: Quick status updates (Product/Product Ops/Infra)
- 15m: RFC #421 batch behavior review (owner: Kaitlyn)
- 20m: Priority decision: API rollout vs Dedicated slot allocation (owners: Zoe + Miguel)
- 10m: Triage/rollout blockers + follow-ups (Sam)
- 5m: Decision log updates & next steps
```

Kaitlyn O'Rourke: I can run the RFC section. Will put a short diff + perf numbers in the thread before the meeting.

Sam Nguyen: Can also bring the canary rollout checklist and the brief on rollback windows. Need to confirm canary timing if we pick Dedicated first.

Jules Martin: Quick ask — could we do a 45m slot instead of 60m? We can spin off a follow-up for decision-log writing. Saves folks' calendars.

Zoe Park: I'd prefer full 60 to avoid a forced follow-up. But open to 45 if we cut the agenda: move triage/rollout blockers offline unless they block the priority decision.

Priya Patel: Time poll — react with :one: for 9am PT, :two: for 11am PT, :three: for 3pm PT.

Miguel Santos: :one:  (9am PT works for infra)

Sam Nguyen: :one:

Kaitlyn O'Rourke: :one: (but I might need to join a few mins late)

Jules Martin: :two: (11am safer for EMEA)

Zoe Park: Noted — majority so far for 9am. If EMEA needs, we can record + post notes.

AgendaBot: Calendar poll closed — 9:00 AM PT selected. Invite sent to attendees with a calendar note to add docs: link to RFC #421, perf figs, and the decision log stub.

Zoe Park: Thanks — please drop any pre-reads in this thread before EOD Fri. Kaitlyn, Priya, Sam: add your 1-slide summary or bullets.

Miguel Santos: Will attach infra capacity spreadsheet and the Dedicated slot forecast.

Priya Patel: I'll add the priority rubric and the small diff + perf table.

Sam Nguyen: I'll post the canary checklist + known rollback windows.

Zoe Park: Great. Agenda owners: Kaitlyn (RFC), Zoe+Miguel (priority decision), Sam (rollout blockers), Priya (rubric). We'll run strict timeboxing. Thanks all :thumbsup:
